title: was / were: Affirmative
grammarTitle: was / were — прошедшее время глагола "to be"
grammarNote:
"Was" и "were" — это формы глагола "to be" (быть) в ПРОШЕДШЕМ времени.

В настоящем времени мы говорим:
"I AM a student." · "She IS from Taraz." · "They ARE happy."

В прошедшем времени (вчера, раньше, в прошлом):
"I WAS a student." · "She WAS from Taraz." · "They WERE happy."

📐 Главное правило:
→ WAS → I / He / She / It (единственное число)
→ WERE → You / We / They (множественное число + you)

💡 Подсказка:
"was" — это прошедшее от "is" (he IS → he WAS)
"were" — это прошедшее от "are" (they ARE → they WERE)

Примеры из рассказа Daniyal:
"Yesterday WAS Tuesday." — Вчера было вторником.
"The weather WAS sunny and warm." — Погода была солнечной и тёплой.
"The lecture WAS on Constitutional Law." — Лекция была по конституционному праву.
"My team WAS the winner!" — Моя команда была победителем!

Примеры из рассказа Ainur:
"My alarm WAS broken." — Мой будильник был сломан.
"The cafeteria WAS crowded." — Кафетерий был переполнен.
"My friends WERE busy." — Мои друзья были заняты.
"The questions WERE very difficult." — Вопросы были очень сложными.

grammarExtra.title: WAS — I / He / She / It (единственное число)

rows.example: "I was in the library for two hours." · "I was tired but satisfied." — Daniyal.
"Dr. Akhanov was outstanding yesterday." · "Rustem was in a good mood." — Daniyal.
"The professor was not pleased." · "Gulnara was kind and caring." — Ainur.
"It was a wonderful day!" · "The weather was sunny." · "The soup was cold."
⚠️ У "was" НЕТ краткой формы в утверждении! "I was" — нельзя сократить до "I's".
"She IS a professor." → "She WAS a professor." · "It IS cold." → "It WAS cold."
"You were very brave to keep studying!" · "You were late, weren't you?"
"We were all relaxed and happy at lunch." · "We were the winners!" — Daniyal.
"They were all excellent participants." · "My friends were busy." — Ainur.
"They ARE busy." → "They WERE busy." · "We ARE happy." → "We WERE happy."
❌ "You was nervous." → ✅ "You were nervous." (даже если один человек — YOU = WERE!)
⚠️ У "were" НЕТ краткой формы в утверждении! "They were" — нельзя сократить.

grammarExtra.title: There was / There were — в прошедшем времени

rows.example: "There was a strong wind yesterday." · "There was an unexpected quiz in the lecture."
"There were no empty tables in the cafeteria." · "There were fifty students in the hall."
"There IS a queue now." → "There WAS a queue yesterday." (длинная!)
"There were some students sleeping in the library." · "There was some bread left."
"Today there IS sun. Yesterday there WAS rain and wind." — Ainur describes her Monday.
❌ "There were a quiz." → ✅ "There WAS a quiz." (quiz = один = was, не were!)
"Yesterday WAS Tuesday." · "Yesterday the weather WAS beautiful." — Daniyal.
"Last Monday WAS a disaster." · "Last semester WAS very difficult for Ainur."
"In October, the weather WAS cold." · "In my first year, the exams WERE very hard."
"Two days ago, I WAS at the debate club." · "An hour ago, she WAS in the cafeteria."
"On Monday, the cafeteria WAS crowded." · "On Tuesday, the beshbarmak WAS delicious."
"That morning WAS a disaster." · "That day WERE the hardest moments of the semester."

grammarTip:
Два правила — и was/were всегда правильно:

① I / He / She / It → WAS (единственное число)
   "I WAS in the library." · "She WAS late." · "The weather WAS sunny."

② You / We / They → WERE (множественное число)
   "We WERE happy." · "They WERE busy." · "You WERE brave!"

⚠️ Внимание на YOU:
   Даже если ты говоришь об одном человеке — YOU = WERE!
   ❌ "You was nervous." → ✅ "You WERE nervous."

🔑 Слова-сигналы прошедшего времени:
   yesterday · last week · last Monday · two days ago · on Tuesday · in October
   Если в предложении есть эти слова → всегда was/were, НЕ am/is/are!

💡 Запомни через Daniyal и Ainur:
   "Yesterday WAS Tuesday. The weather WAS sunny." (Daniyal)
   "My alarm WAS broken. My friends WERE busy." (Ainur)

exercises.text: Yesterday ___ Tuesday — a perfect day for Daniyal.
exercises.hint: "Yesterday" = past. It = singular → WAS. "Yesterday WAS Tuesday." ✅

exercises.text: Ainur's friends ___ all busy during lunchtime.
exercises.hint: Friends = they = plural → WERE. "Her friends WERE busy." ✅

exercises.text: The questions in the quiz ___ very difficult — Ainur was not ready.
exercises.hint: Questions = they = plural → WERE. "The questions WERE very difficult."

exercises.text: "You was nervous before the debate" is correct English.
exercises.hint: YOU always takes WERE — even for one person! → "You WERE nervous." ✅

exercises.text: There ___ an unexpected quiz in the second lecture.
exercises.hint: "A quiz" = one = singular → There WAS a quiz. (not "were a quiz")

exercises.text: Dr. Akhanov ___ outstanding yesterday — his explanations were clear and fascinating.
exercises.hint: Dr. Akhanov = he = singular → WAS. "He WAS outstanding yesterday."

opts: The cafeteria were crowded at lunchtime.
My team was the winners of the debate!
They was all relaxed and happy.
We was in the library all afternoon.
exercises.correct: My team was the winners of the debate!
exercises.hint: My team = it = singular → WAS ✅. "The cafeteria WERE" ❌ (was). "They WAS" ❌ (were). "We WAS" ❌ (were).

exercises.text: "___ Monday, the weather was awful and Ainur was late."
exercises.hint: "Last Monday" = прошлый понедельник. "Last" + day/week/year → past tense was/were. ✅
